title: Unknown Force
body: Two forces are applied to a $$5.0-kg$$ object, and it accelerates at a rate of $$2.0\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}**2}$$ in the positive $$y\$\$-direction$$. $$One$$ $$of$$ $$the$$ $$forces$$ $$acts$$ $$in$$ $$the$$ $$positive$$ $$x\$\$-direction$$ $$with$$ $$magnitude$$ $$12.0$$ $$N$$.
